newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products firmer, fuel up strongly.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products firmer, fuel up strongly.

text.p: NWE oil products were firmer on Wednesday, traders said.
Naphtha rallied after crude held some of its gains and traders suspected several cargoes moving to the U.S.
Gasoline ended steady to slightly higher, pulling back from its highs when NYMEX gasoline retreated.
Gas oil rose $2 with futures but premiums were steady in thin trade stunted by the November IPE play.
High and low sulphur fuel oil were sharply up, with good transatlantic demand supporting prices.
